capability.summary: Summarize JUnit XML suites and testcase statuses
capability.description: Parses one local XML report with lxml and returns suite attributes plus testcase name, classname, time, and a status inferred from failure, error, or skipped child elements.
capability.problem_space: Read-only summarization of non-namespaced JUnit/xUnit-style testsuite/testcase tags; XML namespaces can make bare-tag searches return no suites, and recursively nested suites can cause testcase records to be attributed more than once. Not test execution, strict schema validation, or full report extraction.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing XML report. Output: JSON envelope with a suites array of suite attributes and testcase summaries, or a handled missing-path/XML-syntax error.
accepted_inputs: an existing XML file whose root is testsuite or that contains descendant testsuite elements in JUnit/xUnit style
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "lxml", target: string, suites: [{name: string|null, tests: string|null, failures: string|null, errors: string|null, skipped: string|null, time: string|null, cases: [{name: string|null, classname: string|null, time: string|null, status: "passed"|"failed"|"error"|"skipped"}]}]}, exit 0. Missing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. XML syntax failure: {status: "error", tool: "lxml", message: string}, exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON; other parser/I/O errors may traceback.
limitations: does not validate against a JUnit XML schema and accepts any XML containing testsuite/testcase element names
searches literal bare tags `testsuite` and `testcase`; namespace-qualified JUnit XML elements are not matched and can produce an empty suites array
uses recursive `s.iter("testcase")` for every discovered suite, so testcases under nested suites can appear both under an ancestor suite and again under their nested suite
does not return failure text, error details, skipped reasons, system-out, system-err, properties, or aggregate computed counts
uses lxml default parser settings with no explicit DTD/entity hardening, timeout, size cap, or output truncation; it does not modify the report

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing JUnit suite attributes and per-testcase status summaries, or a handled parse error.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: summarize a JUnit XML test report
extract testcase pass fail error and skipped statuses
negative_intents: run a test suite or rerun failed tests
validate JUnit XML against a schema
extract failure messages logs or full testcase output
